  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Scald (parboil) the {{ing_01|pig}} and marinate."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Place in a sauce pan with {{ing_02|oil}}, {{ing_03|broth}}, {{ing_04|wine}} and {{ing_05|water}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Tie a bunch of {{ing_06|leeks}} and {{ing_07|coriander}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Cook (in the oven)."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When half done, color with {{ing_08|reduced must}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "In the mortar put {{ing_09|pepper}}, {{ing_10|lovage}}, {{ing_11|carraway}}, {{ing_12|origany}}, {{ing_13|celery seed}}, {{ing_14|laser root}} and crush them."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_03|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Add the {{ing_15|pig’s own gravy}} and {{ing_16|raisin wine}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Add this (to the meat in the sauce pan) and let it boil."
    },
    {
      "step": 10,
      "text": "When boiling, bind with {{ing_17|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 11,
      "text": "The {{ing_01|pig}}, placed on a platter, mask (with the sauce)."
    },
    {
      "step": 12,
      "text": "Sprinkle with {{ing_09|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
